meta.note: Luna v2, extracted from the Flutter app (temperatura_maxima: apps/mobile/lib/core/theme/app_theme.dart, lib/core/dsm/luna_metrics.dart, luna_typography.dart) and shared with the website (klaq-pages: src/dsm/).

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background (scaffold). Every screen and page sits on it.

tokens.name: ambient-1
tokens.usage: Top stop of the backdrop gradient (AmbientBackground).

tokens.name: ambient-2
tokens.usage: Middle stop of the backdrop gradient.

tokens.name: ambient-3
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of the backdrop gradient; ends on bg in Dark.

tokens.name: ambient-glow
tokens.usage: Soft glow at the top of the backdrop in the accent color at 10% (movies & series only; transparent in Books and Games). Recompute from the active accent when the accent changes.

tokens.name: elev
tokens.usage: Opaque content surface on bg: cards, grouped lists, notices (LunaSurface). Content is never glass.

tokens.name: elev-2
tokens.usage: Opaque surface on top of elev only: segmented thumb, menu inside a card, inner ring of a selected swatch.

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: Quiet control fill: chips, striped poster placeholder.

tokens.name: fill-2
tokens.usage: Stronger control fill: secondary button, search field, progress and segmented track, inline icon button.

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: 0.5px hairline between list rows, indented to the text.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Glass tint. Navigation chrome only: header/tab bar, floating buttons, menus, sheets, controls over imagery. Always with glass-stroke, glass-highlight, the glass blur and shadow-glass.

tokens.name: glass-stroke
tokens.usage: 0.5px outline of a glass surface (and of the neutral badge).

tokens.name: glass-highlight
tokens.usage: 0.5px inner light along the top edge of glass.

tokens.name: glass-shadow
tokens.usage: Shadow color of glass chrome (0 10 30); the same in every theme.

tokens.name: sheet
tokens.usage: Background of floating sheets (with the glass blur).

tokens.name: label
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, elev and elev-2.

tokens.name: label-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text on bg and elev: metadata, supporting copy, list headers, inactive segment. Holds 4.5:1 on bg and elev in every theme.

tokens.name: label-3
tokens.usage: Decorative only: chevrons, placeholder icons, empty-state glyph. Never for text that must be read.

tokens.name: on-media
tokens.usage: Text and icons over artwork or photos (hero, stills).

tokens.name: on-media-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text over artwork.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Selection, progress fill and the primary action's fill. Not for text on light grounds: use accent-text.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Text and icons in the accent color on bg and elev (links, 'See all', info notices, eyebrows). In Dark it equals accent; in Light a deeper tone.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (primary button) and on every highlight-*; >= 4.7:1 in every theme.

tokens.name: rating
tokens.usage: The rating star. Only next to a star, never in metrics, bars or progress.

tokens.name: rating-text
tokens.usage: The user's own rating number and 'Rate' prompt, beside a star, on bg and elev.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Success and confirmation (synced, strong password, success notice). Text on bg and elev in every theme (>= 4.6:1); icon on a notice tint.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Attention without severity (premieres, 'coming soon', late season, syncing). Text on bg and elev in every theme (>= 4.6:1).

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and errors (sign out, delete, error notice). Text on bg and elev in every theme (>= 4.6:1).

tokens.name: highlight-mint
tokens.usage: Mint (default) highlight: becomes accent when the person picks it (movies & series only).

tokens.name: highlight-mint-text
tokens.usage: Mint (default) highlight as text: becomes accent-text when picked.

tokens.name: highlight-coral
tokens.usage: Coral highlight: becomes accent when the person picks it (movies & series only).

tokens.name: highlight-coral-text
tokens.usage: Coral highlight as text: becomes accent-text when picked.

tokens.name: highlight-spring
tokens.usage: Spring highlight: becomes accent when the person picks it (movies & series only).

tokens.name: highlight-spring-text
tokens.usage: Spring highlight as text: becomes accent-text when picked.

tokens.name: highlight-amber
tokens.usage: Amber highlight: becomes accent when the person picks it (movies & series only).

tokens.name: highlight-amber-text
tokens.usage: Amber highlight as text: becomes accent-text when picked.

tokens.name: media-primary
tokens.usage: Primary button fill over artwork (hero): white with media-primary-text.

tokens.name: media-primary-text
tokens.usage: Label of the primary button over artwork.

tokens.name: media-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary button over artwork: light glass with a 20px blur.

tokens.name: media-track
tokens.usage: Progress track over artwork.

tokens.name: media-plate
tokens.usage: Plate behind an episode code over a still (blur 10, radius 8).

tokens.name: avatar-1-from
tokens.usage: Initials avatar #1: gradient start (135°). Index is saved on the profile; never reorder.

tokens.name: avatar-1-to
tokens.usage: Initials avatar #1: gradient end. White initials on it.

tokens.name: avatar-2-from
tokens.usage: Initials avatar #2: gradient start (135°). Index is saved on the profile; never reorder.

tokens.name: avatar-2-to
tokens.usage: Initials avatar #2: gradient end. White initials on it.

tokens.name: avatar-3-from
tokens.usage: Initials avatar #3: gradient start (135°). Index is saved on the profile; never reorder.

tokens.name: avatar-3-to
tokens.usage: Initials avatar #3: gradient end. White initials on it.

tokens.name: avatar-4-from
tokens.usage: Initials avatar #4: gradient start (135°). Index is saved on the profile; never reorder.

tokens.name: avatar-4-to
tokens.usage: Initials avatar #4: gradient end. White initials on it.

tokens.name: avatar-5-from
tokens.usage: Initials avatar #5: gradient start (135°). Index is saved on the profile; never reorder.

tokens.name: avatar-5-to
tokens.usage: Initials avatar #5: gradient end. White initials on it.

tokens.name: avatar-6-from
tokens.usage: Initials avatar #6: gradient start (135°). Index is saved on the profile; never reorder.

tokens.name: avatar-6-to
tokens.usage: Initials avatar #6: gradient end. White initials on it.

tokens.name: avatar-7-from
tokens.usage: Initials avatar #7: gradient start (135°). Index is saved on the profile; never reorder.

tokens.name: avatar-7-to
tokens.usage: Initials avatar #7: gradient end. White initials on it.

tokens.name: avatar-8-from
tokens.usage: Initials avatar #8: gradient start (135°). Index is saved on the profile; never reorder.

tokens.name: avatar-8-to
tokens.usage: Initials avatar #8: gradient end. White initials on it.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "SF Pro Display", system-ui, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: large-title
styles.usage: Screen title (LunaStandardScreen); page title on the web.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Hero and detail title, profile name.

styles.name: title-3
styles.usage: Smaller title: Timeline day, empty state, card heading.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Registre o que você assistiu e dê sua nota.

styles.name: footnote
styles.usage: Metadata, counts, captions, list headers and footers.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase overline (StatusPill, section eyebrow). Text is set in caps by the component.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Episode code (EpisodeCode), tabular figures, in accent-text.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: Highlight number (hours on profile, hero stat), tabular.

styles.name: rating-hero
styles.usage: Big rating in the rating sheet, tabular, in rating-text.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Web only: landing hero headline on wide screens (rating-hero's size and tracking). Steps down to display-sm under 720px.

styles.name: display-sm
styles.usage: Web only: hero headline on phones and section titles on wide screens (metric's metrics).

tokens.name: s4
tokens.usage: 4pt grid step: icon-to-label gaps, badge padding.

tokens.name: s8
tokens.usage: Button icon gap, list header bottom, small stacks.

tokens.name: s12
tokens.usage: Section title bottom, item gaps.

tokens.name: s16
tokens.usage: Card header to content; list header inset.

tokens.name: s20
tokens.usage: Card padding (LunaCard).

tokens.name: s24
tokens.usage: Grid step.

tokens.name: s32
tokens.usage: List header top; empty state vertical padding.

tokens.name: s40
tokens.usage: Grid step.

tokens.name: s56
tokens.usage: Largest grid step.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Side margin of every screen: titles, cards, rails and grids align on it. On the web, the page gutter under 720px.

tokens.name: item
tokens.usage: Gap between sibling items in a list, rail or grid.

tokens.name: section
tokens.usage: Gap between blocks of a screen (SectionTitle top).

tokens.name: row-v
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of list rows.

tokens.name: tab-bar-inset
tokens.usage: Bottom inset of screens under the floating tab bar (62 + 30 + air). App only.

tokens.name: gutter-web
tokens.usage: Web only: page gutter from 720px up.

tokens.name: section-web
tokens.usage: Web only: vertical gap between landing sections from 720px up (72px below).

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Web only: max width of the page column.

tokens.name: radius-spine
tokens.usage: Book cover spine side.

tokens.name: radius-thumb
tokens.usage: Stills, list posters, app icon in rows.

tokens.name: radius-poster
tokens.usage: Grid and rail posters, theme previews.

tokens.name: radius-group
tokens.usage: Grouped lists, rows, fields, notices, default LunaSurface.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Hero and large cards.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Floating sheets; phone frame on the web.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Capsules: buttons, chips, search field, tab bar, circular controls.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Glass chrome (GlassSurface): header, floating buttons, tab bar.

tokens.name: shadow-thumb
tokens.usage: Segmented control thumb.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: Glass menus (LunaPopupMenuButton), taller than the bar.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Lifted book cover ('Reading now'); phone frame on the web.

duration.note: LunaMotion durations. Animate what changed; nothing loops; prefers-reduced-motion jumps to the end value.

tokens.name: motion-fast
tokens.usage: Touch feedback (pressed scale).

tokens.name: motion-standard
tokens.usage: Control state change: selection, color, opacity, icon.

tokens.name: motion-emphasized
tokens.usage: Block entrance and layout changes.

tokens.name: motion-entrance
tokens.usage: StaggeredEntrance per block (rise 18px), 70ms apart.

tokens.name: motion-stagger
tokens.usage: Delay between blocks of a StaggeredEntrance.

tokens.name: motion-skeleton
tokens.usage: Skeleton to content swap.

tokens.name: motion-theme
tokens.usage: Light/dark switch (background only).

tokens.name: motion-page
tokens.usage: Page transition forward.

tokens.name: motion-page-reverse
tokens.usage: Page transition back.

tokens.name: motion-context
tokens.usage: Context switch color slide (movies, books, games).

tokens.name: motion-fill
tokens.usage: Progress bar fill, with ease-fill.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Default curve (easeOutCubic).

tokens.name: ease-context
tokens.usage: Context switch (easeInOutCubic).

tokens.name: ease-theme
tokens.usage: Theme switch (easeInOut).

tokens.name: ease-fill
tokens.usage: Progress fill: starts fast, settles slowly.

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: Web stand-in for LunaMotion.spring (response 0.35s, damping 0.85): selection, switch, segmented thumb.

tokens.name: glass-blur
tokens.usage: The one glass blur (GlassFilter), always with glass-saturate.

tokens.name: glass-saturate
tokens.usage: Saturation applied under the glass blur, so glass is not grey.

tokens.name: media-blur
tokens.usage: Blur of the secondary button over artwork.

tokens.name: pressed-scale
tokens.usage: Scale of a control while pressed (LunaPressable).

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Separator, glass stroke and glass highlight width.
